news.title: Iran rejects U.S. ceasefire offer, demands sovereignty over Strait of Hormuz
news.description: President Donald Trump has claimed the U.S. and Iran are "in negotiations now." But the Islamic Republic denies any direct talks to end the war.

news.title: Jury in Los Angeles finds Meta, YouTube negligent in social media addiction trial
news.description: A jury reached a verdict in the LA trial focused on Meta and YouTube, a case that experts have characterized as social media's "Big Tobacco" moment.

news.title: White House says Trump will meet Xi in China in May
news.description: A long-awaited meeting between President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping will take place in Beijing on May 14 and 15, the White House said.
